name: bridges-e2e-tests
description: E2E tests for Gnosis Chain bridges (xDAI bridge & Omnibridge)

scripts.test:xdai: npm run test:xdai:usds-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:dai-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-usds && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-dai
scripts.test:omni: npm run test:omni:eth-to-weth && npm run test:omni:weth-to-eth && npm run test:omni:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:omni:gno-gc-to-eth
scripts.test: npm run test:xdai && npm run test:omni
scripts.test:xdai:autoclaim: npm run test:xdai:usds-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:dai-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-usds --autoclaim && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-dai --autoclaim
scripts.test:omni:autoclaim: npm run test:omni:eth-to-weth && npm run test:omni:weth-to-eth --autoclaim && npm run test:omni:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:omni:gno-gc-to-eth --autoclaim
scripts.test:autoclaim: npm run test:xdai:autoclaim && npm run test:omni:autoclaim
